comments:
5bcfed73: ;
 .;This is the input filter for DGJXE10 xref
 .;This code is used to set and kill different nodes in the ^VAS(393
 .;global for a particular entry.
65a9efe6: ;Call the DE subroutine and go to BEGIN label

967e8781: ;Set up variables for input transform. DIE is the global root. DIC is the same value. DP is the file number. DL is the computed length of the field data. DIEL is 0, indicating this is not a word processing field. DU will contain set of codes allowed for the field. If no existing value then quit.
72572993: ;If a value already exists for the field, save it in DE(1)
bb78ac4f: ;Kill scratch global root %Z and quit
1ae4bbfd: ;Write prompt for field
b636e8f8: ;Quit
7d1f0f52: ;Call the W subroutine to write prompt. Output Y which is the existing value for the field. If existing value extends beyond column 45, write on a new line, column 9.
344c7006: ;If the field can only contain values with a length <=19 and is not word-processing, and also not a set of codes type or a MUMPS code type, then branch to RW^DIR2 to handle input.

3df4f3c8: ;If the field has an existing value Y, output '// ' separator. If this is not a word processing field, the DIC("S") input transform is defined, and there is a sequence number for the cross reference in DE(DQ), then write '(No Editing)' and quit.
860157a1: ;Read input value X with timeout DTIME. If timeout, set DTOUT=1 and X='^'. If input is just return/enter, set X='^'.
c9b7d826: ;Quit
62eec2f5: ;Kill DQ(DQ) scratch node. Increment DQ sequence #.
4076daa9: ;Branch to the next DQ sequence code.
f9af195d: ;If there is an existing value in DE(DQ), go to PR label, else call W to output prompt and TR to get input.
6f577af1: ;If X is null, either loop back to get more input if field is not required, quit if not a new entry, loop back if a new entry.
599633f7: ;If input is '?', go to QS to display help. If input starts with '^', call D subroutine and go to ^DIE17.
57ae3985: ;If input is '@', call D subroutine and go to Z^DIE2.

e7af4534: ;If input is ' ', field allows LAYGO, this user has a LAYGO value for this field, the field does not allow MULTIPLY VALUES, and does not have a specific LAYGO syntax defined, then display the LAYGO value and set X to that value.

dcea6b6d: ;If field is word-processing, multiple, or has an input transform, branch to code to handle those cases. Otherwise, if there is piece of DU that matches X, and the DIC('S') input transform passes, move piece to Y, output it if not already displayed, and go to V to file the value.
a517cd35: ;If no piece of DU matches X, loop through all pieces to find the closest match. Output the match and set X to the piece value.
1f44fade: ;If no match found, output the remainder of DU and set X to null.
7a19260e: If the lookup value is not found, quit and return a negative value.
5b258b7e: If the value is a number greater than 24 digits, clear the value and quit.
1ce34a5f: If the value includes a decimal point and the field is not a dollar amount, remove leading and trailing zeros from the decimal portion.
ac2f712a: Execute any server-side data transformation logic and clear the YS array.
3f775737: If the value is valid, store it in the DG array and optionally in the ^DISV global, then quit.
325fed56: If the value is invalid, display an error message and branch to the error handling routine.
105054d9: Set the value to a standard error message.
2bcb416c: If the value is a question mark, execute any field-specific code and branch to the help routine.
58b6a2ae: Set up the DIFLD variable and the DQ array with field-specific information.
e2a923aa: If the value is null, execute any field-specific logic. If the value is @, branch to the appropriate routine based on the field properties.
49c7afa8: If the field has a server-side transform, execute it and branch to the replication logic.
2966c7cf: If the field is a pointer to a file entry, retrieve the internal entry number and execute any field-specific replication logic.
d1393ff8: If the field is a pointer to a variable pointer, retrieve the internal entry number and execute any field-specific replication logic.
4f7f6d1e: If the field has any MUMPS code in its DD global node, execute it. If the field has a set of codes, retrieve the appropriate one.
7dc5fd1e: ;Process the logic for the DATE/TIME validation type.
ad279c0b: If the input value does not begin with either 'I' or '#' then branch to the RD label.
9bbce991: Call the DIE0 routine to validate the input. If the X variable is defined after the call, or the PR label is reached, then branch.
ac98aaa4: Exit the routine.
ad975c73: Initialize variables for the KIDS input template. DNM is the name of the template, DQ is the sequence number.
a86200c5: Set variables for the first field in the template. DW is the file location, DV is the validation pattern, DU is the lookup global root, DLB is the label text, DIFLD is the field number.
5b1a1bc3: Set the lookup global root for the DU variable.
b0ce9247: Branch to the RE label.
6af73861: Exit the X1 label.
0ddf3b8d: If the DG array contains data, call the DIE17 routine and execute the X2 code block. Set DQ to 2 and depending on the value of Y, either branch to A or execute the OUT^DIE17 routine.
7e7794bc: If the input value is blank, set multiple nodes in the VAS(393 global to blank and set the DGJTST variable to 'INCOMPLETE' and Y to '@2'.
b13aaf43: Exit the X2 label.
f67613a4: If the DG array contains data, call the DIE17 routine and execute the X3 code block. Set DQ to 3 and depending on the value of Y, either branch to A or execute the OUT^DIE17 routine.
38feaf10: Set the DGJTST variable to 'DICTATED'.
6cfb9836: Exit the X3 label.
a5eef7fb: Set the sequence number DQ to 5.
56024180: If the DG array contains data, call the DIE17 routine. Then branch to the ^DGJXE11 routine.
